votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of October 17, 2023, and November 7, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from its formal sessions on October 17 and November 7, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 81 of 2023 Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 as seen on the motion sheet.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted the third budget amendment for FY2023-24, which includes new paramedic employees, a new Legislative Division in the City Attorney's Office, and over $6 million in additional transportation impact fees among other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 82 of 2023 Rezone at Approximately 1380 South 900 West.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning properties at approximately 1380 South 900 West, 1361 South 1000 West, and 1367 South 1000 West from R-1/7,000 to RMF-30 to accommodate future redevelopment.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 78 of 2023 for the rezone at 2157 South Lincoln Street, subject to the property owner entering a development agreement with specified conditions regarding preservation of the Victorian home, sidewalk construction, and a 50-year covenant running with the land.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning 2157 South Lincoln Street from RB to CSHBD2, conditioned on a development agreement requiring preservation of the existing Victorian home's exterior and improvements to surrounding sidewalks and landscaping.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 36 of 2023, officially adopting a Code of Conduct for the Salt Lake City Council.
votes.description: The Council adopted a formal Code of Conduct establishing behavioral and ethical standards for City Council members.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 79 of 2023 enacting temporary land use regulations authorizing a temporary shelter community at approximately 255 South 600 West Street.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance authorizing a temporary shelter community pilot program at 255 South 600 West for up to six months, providing portable living structures for up to 50 persons experiencing homelessness.

votes.motion: Defer action on the resolution requesting emergency medical service personnel admission to the Firefighters Retirement System to a future date.
votes.description: The Council voted to table the resolution that would have requested admission of paramedics and social workers to the Tier 2 Firefighter Utah Retirement System, deferring it to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 80 of 2023 amending section 2.08.040 of the Salt Lake City Code creating a Division of Legislative Affairs and clarifying functions of the City Attorney's Office.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending the City Code to formally create a Division of Legislative Affairs within the City Attorney's Office and clarify the office's functions, including the City Recorder and outside counsel roles.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda except for items G2 and G5.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including board appointments and a public hearing date setting, excluding the Planning Commission appointment (G2) and Airport Board appointment (G5) for separate votes.

votes.motion: Approve item G2 – Board Appointment: Planning Commission – Brian Scott.
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Brian Scott to the Planning Commission for a term ending December 12, 2027; Council Member Mano recused himself from this vote.
